author: hattrill
body:
Hi @LiNiMGI and @sramachand
Surf1 MGI:98443
surf1 ZFIN:ZDB-GENE-041108-2
have exp annotations to cytochrome-c oxidase activity, but this is an GO:0033617 mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly

title: Surf1 annotations

author: LiNiMGI
body:
it functions as an assembly factor, we don't have a GO term for that.
I just removed the cytochrome-c oxidase activity annotation, changed it to the suggested process annotation. thanks @hattrill
